 Live: Casa Pia vs Sporting CP | Liga Portugal
 Sporting CP visit Casa Pia looking to secure three crucial points and remain in contention near the top of the Liga Portugal standings.
 Don't miss the match between Casa Pia and Sporting CP on beIN SPORTS. 
 Sporting CP Look to Regain Ground in Liga Portugal
 Matchday 10 of Liga Portugal kicks off with a clash that could have major implications at both ends of the standings. Sporting CP travel to face Casa Pia at the Estádio Municipal de Rio Maior, determined to regain confidence and stay close to the league's leading teams.
 The Lions enter the match in third place with 18 points after a start to the season that has featured impressive performances alongside some unexpected results.
 Rui Borges' side are looking to return to winning ways in the league, particularly following their recent defeat against Académico de Viseu .
 However, the Lisbon club managed to restore some confidence during the week with a 2-1 victory over Marítimo in the Taça da Liga , securing a place in the semifinals.
 Casa Pia Aim to Surprise the Lions
 The situation is very different for Casa Pia , who sit 16th with just seven points and desperately need to start collecting points to move away from the relegation zone.
 Nevertheless, Filipe Coelho's side enter the match with renewed confidence after securing an important 2-0 victory over Estrela da Amadora .
 João Rego and Lawrence Ofori scored the goals in that encounter, giving the Geese a much-needed boost ahead of their meeting with one of the strongest teams in the competition.
 Their biggest challenge will be reproducing that performance at home, where they have yet to register a victory in Liga Portugal this season.
 Recent history also heavily favors Sporting CP , who have won their latest league meetings against Casa Pia .
 Luis Suárez, One of Sporting's Biggest Threats
 One of the home side's main concerns will be containing Luis Suárez , a striker who has become an important attacking figure for Sporting CP .
 Geny Catamo's pace and Gonçalo Inácio's ability to build attacks from the back also provide valuable weapons for Rui Borges' team.
 Meanwhile, Casa Pia will look to remain defensively organized and take advantage of opportunities on the counterattack.
 The match brings together two teams with very different objectives: Sporting CP are determined to stay in the title race, while Casa Pia need points to climb away from the bottom of the table.
